expect.optimalWindow: Late winter to spring, conditions dependent

April.reason: Frequently the most reliable window before spring warming destabilizes the snowpack

March.reason: Often in condition; requires careful stability assessment before committing

January.reason: Cold, often unstable snowpack typical of mid-winter storm cycles

December.reason: Couloir may not be fully formed; short daylight and early-season instability

February.reason: Line often building into condition but storm-driven avalanche danger tends to be elevated

value.optimalWindow: Late spring into midsummer, on firm snow

May.reason: Glacier and couloir are normally fully snow-covered; check for lingering avalanche hazard after storms and warm spells

June.reason: A commonly climbed month; the snow is usually consolidated and firm early in the day

July.reason: Still commonly climbed, though the glacier firms up toward ice and the couloir starts to thin

August.reason: Hard blue ice often shows on the glacier and the couloir melts toward loose talus; crampons and care are essential
